name: security
description: Bot and spam protection for public forms: Postgres-backed rate limiting, honeypot + submit-timing guards, same-origin checks, disposable email filtering and Cloudflare Turnstile.

env.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
env.description: Used by checkRateLimit via the admin client (server only).

env.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
env.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key. TurnstileWidget renders nothing without it.

env.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
env.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret. verifyTurnstile fails closed without it.
